glosses: rubber (pliable material derived from the sap of the rubber tree)
eraser (thing used to remove something written or drawn by a pen or a pencil)

examples.text: Não é permitido o uso de borracha.
examples.en: You're not allowed to use an eraser.

examples.text: Os pneus são feitos de borracha sintética.
examples.en: Tires are made from synthetic rubber.

examples.text: O pato de borracha do meu filho é amarelo.
examples.en: My son's rubber duck is yellow.

examples.text: O Tom pegou minha borracha emprestada.
